title: This world has never had weather. Tonight it gets a storm.
intro: The tent at dusk, its canvas tearing at the pegs. This world has only ever known one calm noon: no wind, no night, no cloud. Now all of it arrives at once. Flashes: snow driven sideways, the sky gone black, the tent a pale shape in the dark. One tent. One citizen inside. Does anything still stand in the morning?
